dljv31xue.text: CYRUS — CANONICAL VISUAL AND STORY OVERRIDE. Match the latest approved 'Cyrus: Graphite interceptor character sheet' exactly. Cyrus no longer knows—and does not care to examine—where stewardship ended and exploitation began. Immaculately fitted graphite technical armor with minimal seams, architectural silhouette, restrained amber-cyan status lines and heavy matte-black tactical boots. Never put him in Launch-Shop canvas as his default, obsolete white/chrome armor, or bulky fantasy plating. Any contradictory older scene/export prose is obsolete.
